name: Iron Sword
summary: A plain iron longsword, the reliable companion of any novice traveler.
detail: Forged repeatedly from common iron ore by dwarven smiths. The blade is slightly rusted yet still keen, well-balanced and wieldable with one hand. Though unenchanted, in skilled hands it cleaves through goblin leather with ease. Many a legend begins with this humble blade.

name: Frostblade
summary: A magical longsword imbued with frost; hits slow the enemy.
detail: A wisp of eternal permafrost is sealed within the hilt, and frost condenses along the blade with every swing. Wounds it opens freeze into ice crystals, leaving foes sluggish. Forged by the ice mages of the North to stand against dragons, the crossguard bears ancient frost-runes. Requires considerable strength to wield.

name: Elven Longbow
summary: An heirloom bow of the forest elves; long range, high precision.
detail: Crafted from thousand-year yew and strung with elven sinew, the limbs are etched all over with vine patterns. Only one pure of heart may draw it full, and the arrow flies straight as a falling star. Elven rangers use it to pick off foes a hundred paces away.

name: Earthshatter Hammer
summary: A dwarven warhammer so heavy a single blow cracks the earth.
detail: The head is cast from star-iron, heavier than a grown man can lift. When it falls the ground itself shudders, smashing shields and bone alike. Only warriors of prodigious strength can master it. A dwarven king once sundered a city gate with a single strike.

name: Viper Dagger
summary: An assassination dagger envenomed with deadly poison; light and lethal.
detail: The blade is coated with the glandular secretion of the marsh basilisk; even a shallow scratch festers and rots. The entry token of the Assassins' Guild, with a sharkskin-wrapped hilt for grip. Near weightless, easy to conceal.

name: Staff of Holy Light
summary: A focus for clerics and paladins; channels healing and holy light.
detail: Crowned with a lightstone that sheds a soft glow in darkness, its bearer may channel divine power to mend wounds and banish undead. Blessed by the first saintess, it has endured a century without fading.

name: Leather Armor
summary: Light armor of tanned leather; agile but limited protection.
detail: Cut from beast-hide and tanned many times, with ample room at the joints. It turns no direct thrust but cushions blunt blows while preserving agility. Favored by rogues and rangers.

name: Chainmail
summary: Medium armor of interlocked iron rings; a balanced choice.
detail: Tens of thousands of rings linked one by one, heavy and sturdy, turning aside slashes with ease. Its flaws are the tedious donning and only middling protection against thrusts. Standard kit for knights and sellswords.

name: Plate Armor
summary: Full-body armor of forged steel plates; top-tier protection.
detail: Riveted from curved steel plates that deflect most blows. Staggeringly heavy; the untrained can scarce move in it, yet clad thus one becomes a walking fortress. The mark of noble knights.

name: Arcane Robe
summary: A mage's robe embroidered with runes; raises maximum mana.
detail: Woven of moon-silk, the garment is stitched all over with arcane sigils that gather free mana. Physical protection is near nil, yet it markedly boosts a caster's mana pool and recovery.

name: Dragonscale Shield
summary: A tower shield reinforced with true dragon scales; blocks dragonbreath.
detail: The crimson scales inlaid in its face reflect flame, one of the few defenses that can take dragonbreath head-on. Its bearer once sheltered a whole squad beneath it in dragonfire; scorch marks remain to this day.

name: Health Potion
summary: A crimson draught that restores a moderate amount of health when drunk.
detail: Brewed from lifebloom herb, red as blood, bitter on the tongue with a sweet aftertaste. The most common life-saver in any adventurer's pack, quickly quaffed mid-combat to recover vitality.

name: Mana Potion
summary: A blue draught that restores mana when drunk.
detail: Mixed from moonpetal and arcane crystal dust, clear and faintly blue; drinking it numbs the tongue. A mage's lifeline, that one extra spell at the crucial moment often turning the tide.

name: Antidote Herb
summary: A bitter herb chewed to clear poisoning.
detail: A grey-green plant growing at the marsh's edge, vilely bitter yet able to neutralize many toxins. In the viper-dagger-haunted underdungeons, it is the key to staying alive.

name: Inferno Bomb
summary: An alchemical flask that bursts into flame on impact, dealing area fire damage.
detail: The alchemist seals fire-oil and unstable crystal in a clay flask that bursts when hurled. One in a tight corridor clears the room, though care is needed not to scorch allies.

name: Town Portal Scroll
summary: A one-use scroll that teleports you to the nearest town when read.
detail: Scribed in dragon-blood ink, the teleportation array activates when torn open with a short incantation, bearing the holder back to the nearest safe town. A last-resort escape, though the destination cannot be chosen.

name: Enhancement Stone
summary: A mysterious ore used to enhance weapons and armor.
detail: A crystal holding stable energy, used at the smithy to bind enhancement properties onto gear. Each item accepts only so many enhancements, and failure risks destruction; seasoned adventurers hoard them for the moment that matters.

name: Goblin
summary: Small, cunning green-skinned creatures that roam in packs.
detail: Standing only to a grown man's waist, with ink-green skin, pointed ears and jagged teeth. One alone is no threat, but they favor ambush in numbers, hurling stones. A chieftain rules each pack; slay him and the band scatters.

name: Skeleton Warrior
summary: A sword-bearing skeleton raised by a necromancer; knows no fatigue.
detail: Bones driven by dark sorcery, with will-o'-the-wisp flame flickering in the eye sockets. They feel no pain and know no fear, swinging mechanically until shattered. Holy light and blunt weapons are bane to them.

name: Magma Slime
summary: A scalding ooze that lairs in volcanic lands.
detail: A semi-fluid creature, red throughout and perpetually boiling and bubbling; mere touch sears flesh. It splits into two smaller offspring when struck, hard to root out. Frost magic chills it solid and brittle.

name: Gargoyle
summary: A winged fiend that poses as a statue, then lunges at prey.
detail: It rests stock-still as carved stone on old castle eaves until prey draws near; then the stone splits open and it leaps, wings spread. Its hide is hard as rock, shrugging off physical blows; lightning magic cracks the petrified shell.

name: Troll
summary: A giant of immense strength that regenerates severed limbs.
detail: Over ten feet tall, with bark-like grey-green skin. Its terror is astonishing regeneration; wounds close before the eyes. Only fire and acid inflict wounds that will not heal, the key to felling it.

name: Ancient Dragon
summary: A legendary beast atop a mountain of gold; breathes dragonfire.
detail: Sheathed in impenetrable crimson scales, wings that blot the sun. Its breath melts stone, its roar shatters the heart. Legend says the hero who slays it wins its hoard and a dragon-heart granting near-immortality. This is usually the journey's end.

name: Fireball
summary: A basic attack spell that hurls a condensed orb of fire that bursts on impact.
detail: The mage's first lesson; free fire essence is compressed into a sphere and hurled at the target, bursting to scorch nearby foes. Fast to cast and cheap in mana, it is the staple of any caster's offense. At higher tiers it becomes Chain Fireball and Meteor.

name: Heal
summary: A holy spell that restores health to a single ally.
detail: The cleric's core art, mending flesh with divine power. Higher tiers restore more per cast, and the greatest healing can even rejoin severed limbs. The bedrock of any party's endurance.

name: Invisibility
summary: Renders the caster briefly invisible, for stealth and disengagement.
detail: Light bends around the caster, rendering them as if transparent. Movement or attack breaks the effect, so it serves chiefly for scouting and escape. Duration grows with skill.

name: Chain Lightning
summary: Releases a bolt of lightning that leaps between multiple foes.
detail: From the fingertips flies an arc that, on striking the first foe, leaps to the next nearby one, up to several jumps. Vastly effective against clustered enemies, though each jump deals less than the last.

name: Taunt
summary: A warrior's skill that draws enemy aggro to protect allies.
detail: A threatening roar that forces nearby foes to turn their attacks upon the caster. The tank's stock-in-trade, letting fragile mages and archers fire in safety.

name: Teleport
summary: An advanced spell that instantly moves the caster to a point in view.
detail: Tears space for a short displacement, crossing obstacles or escaping peril. Casting requires brief focus and is interrupted by being struck. Masters of the art come and go across the battlefield like the wind.

name: Resurrection
summary: A forbidden-tier spell that revives a just-fallen ally.
detail: With vast mana it calls back a soul still lingering at the boundary. The casting is long, the mana cost immense, and failure invites backlash. Where healing draughts run dry, it is the final hope.
